posts.title: Seven endings, one applicant
posts.description: Automattic is the only applicant left for .jazz, .php, .soul, .wordpress, .tumblr, .woo and .matt, Matt Mullenweg wrote after String Confirmation Day. None of them is approved yet, and objections stay open until 16 March 2027.

posts.title: Short links are not permalinks
posts.description: On 15 November 2026, bit.ly links in 2011 tweets from Burger King and McDonald's started opening Wikipedia pages on Nazi camps and 9/11. Someone had registered the old short codes again. Bitly confirmed the problem that evening and disabled the links.

posts.title: The .name addresses will stay, for now
posts.description: Verisign will keep existing third-level .name addresses and email forwarding as long as a registrar still sells them, reversing July's plan to delete about 22,000 names. New registrations still end.
